name: s4_sudden_change
description: Scenario 4: sudden change of behaviour. An adult walks from the right-hand pavement toward the road at 1.4 m/s, stops at the kerb edge (1.5 m along the path) for 1.5 s, then runs across at 3.5 m/s (accelerating at 6 m/s^2). The timed start makes the pedestrian reach the ego lane at the same moment as the front of the car (trigger.arrivalOffsetS = 0), counting the stop and the run. Ego 50 km/h. Same scene as scenario 4.
